design.decision: Bid what you can make, with no reward for overbidding. It is worth more as the build stacks +multipliers.
design.opponent: Shown on the first make. A set denies it.
design.rationale: This is a common ×mult kept under the ceiling by a small factor. It scales with later +mult, so it stays relevant late in the run where flat points fade.
design.draftText: ×1.3 contract multiplier if your team makes its contract

history.note: draft-common: the enumerator also produced this signature (e-make-xmult); credited to both sources.
